title: Silver Buffalo Sanrio Hello Kitty and Friends Rainbow Stainless Steel Tumbler
categoryName: Collectibles:Animation Art & Merchandise:Animation Merchandise:Other Animation Merchandise
descriptionText:
This Silver Buffalo Sanrio Hello Kitty and Friends Rainbow Stainless Steel Tumbler is a must-have for any Hello Kitty collector or fan. Made of durable stainless steel, it features a colorful rainbow design with Hello Kitty and her friends. The tumbler is perfect for keeping your beverages hot or cold, and it is sure to make a statement wherever you take it.

Whether you use it for your morning coffee or as a decorative piece on your shelf, this tumbler is a great addition to any collection. The brand, Hello Kitty, is known for its quality and this tumbler is no exception. So, why wait? Add this unique and fun Hello Kitty tumbler to your collection today!
